description: Flavour graph for The Dead Pigeon. Called by script_venue_regular via the trigger's voice param.

f0.text: The pigeon watches you sit down with the flat indifference of something that has watched you sit down four hundred times.

f1.text: Someone at the far end lifts a glass an inch. You have never spoken to them. They know exactly who you are.

f2.text: The bartender starts a story mid-sentence, assuming correctly that you were here for the first half of it last week.

r0.text: The bartender is already reaching for a glass before you have said anything, which in here counts as a parade.

r1.text: "Look who it is." Not warm. But it's a sentence, aimed at you, using a tone.

r2.text: Your usual stretch of counter has been wiped. Recently. Possibly on purpose.

s0.text: Nobody looks up. The pigeon does, but the pigeon is dead and has been for some time.

s1.text: The bartender clocks you, prices you, and decides you aren't worth remembering yet.

s2.text: Someone slides their coat further along the bar. Not to make room. To make a point.

name: Venue voice — The Dead Pigeon
